title: byom-mcp tool-schema document (C3a; amendment A4)
description: Closed meta-schema for mcp/byom-mcp.tools.json — the versioned MCP tool bundle binding the C3a sheet's exact candidate and participant op lists (plan/sheets/C3a.md; candidate profile normative via design/2026-07-25-amendment-family-contract.md A4). Tool names are closed per-profile enums, so a governance, runtime, or admin operation as a tool name fails this schema (deny-by-absence); the profiles object is itself closed — no third profile can exist. Per-tool input schemas are derived from the spec/schemas/ops request schemas minus the channel/bridge envelope {version, op, meta}; the field-level subset, access, and channel-derived-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by conformance/run.py's c3a check.

version.description: Version of this tool-schema document (a lock-manifest row per the C3a sheet).

bpp_protocol_version.description: The BPP protocol minor version whose op schemas these tools bind (§14.1).

source.description: Provenance pins: the closed op lists come from the C3a sheet, the candidate binding semantics from amendment A4, the input schemas from the committed op request schemas.

profiles.description: Exactly the two C3a profiles; closed — no governance, runtime, admin, or any other profile exists.

assertion.const: No governance, runtime, or admin tool exists in either profile, ever.

excluded_surfaces.description: The deny-by-absence assertion (C3a sheet; A4: no human-authority, governance, or admin tool on the candidate binding). The exact-list checks make it structural; this records it in the document itself.

candidateToolName.description: The exact candidate-profile tool set (A4: exposing exactly membership_refuse, membership_accept, candidate_self_policy_propose).

participantToolName.description: The exact participant-profile tool set — the C3a sheet's participant list in sheet order, deduplicated (the sheet lists activity_show twice; one tool binds it). Participant/projection surfaces only.

candidateBinding.description: A4 verbatim: sender-constrained to exactly one MembershipOffer, its proposed Manifestation, its control-domain binding, and its onboarding fence; closed server-side on admission, refusal, revocation, or expiry (terminal offer fencing per §7.4); never converts in place — the participant channel is a new credential minted at admission; elicitation through the binding is never assent.

participantBinding.description: The §14.10 participant/harness binding: a participant channel credential minted at admission (A4), participant and projection surfaces only; elicitation is never assent.

op.description: The §14.6 catalog operation this tool binds; name must equal byom_<op> (conformance-checked).

op_request_schema.description: The committed spec/schemas/ops request schema the input schema derives from; null exactly when no op schema is committed yet (the tool then exposes zero args — conformance-checked).

access.description: The akson-mcp marking: read-only tools are safe to allow; authority-bearing (mutating) tools stay gated so each call is a deliberate yes.

propertyNames.description: Optional propertyNames keyword an embedded closed schema may carry (also satisfies the spec convention that a member bag containing schema-keyword names declares its extension names).

inputSchema.description: A closed embedded JSON Schema: the op request schema minus the channel/bridge envelope {version, op, meta} (the bridge derives protocol version from negotiation and MutationMeta from channel state; channel-derived fields per gap note G16 never appear). additionalProperties false is mandatory — an input carrying an undeclared or channel-derived field fails the tool call.
